findings.title: The participle turns an act contrast into a role contrast
findings.claim: The denial reaches beyond a single worship act: the addressees are not positioned as worshippers toward the speaker's worship object, while the speaker's worship is presented as an ongoing act.
findings.mechanism: The carrier عَٰبِدُونَ is an explicit second-person plural active participle, whereas أَعْبُدُ is a first-person imperfect inside the object expression. The preceding verbal panel and the supplied enduring-identity parallels make that form difference function as role against enacted action.
findings.reader_payoff: The line becomes more than an inverted repetition of the preceding denial: it draws a boundary around who occupies the worshipper relation and how the speaker's own act is presented.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading, 'you do not worship what I worship,' remains intact. The role distinction is inferred from the supplied forms and connections; it does not claim that every historical act by either party is fixed forever.

epistemic.reason: The focus morphology and both focus occurrences are supplied, a trusted publication anchors the form contrast, and legacy reader traces provide the before-and-after semantic articulation.

findings.title: Worship carries an honor-and-service relation

findings.mechanism: The focus's worshipper predicate is directed through مَا أَعْبُدُ, while the supplied B006 facets describe the worship relation as treating its object as worthy and serving it as a consequence of that elevated standing. The 12:40 and 19:81 connections supply wider authority-and-honor triggers.
findings.reader_payoff: The denial concerns the value assigned to the worshipped object as well as the outward performance of worship, so the object-side of the sentence becomes visible.
findings.containment: The ordinary worship reading remains the floor. This finding adds the honor-and-service pressure without identifying the focus object beyond the supplied evidence or turning every use of the root into honor language.

epistemic.reason: A trusted cross-run finding and two legacy reader traces anchor the branch relation; the wider connections supply target Arabic but no target morphology, so the secondary facets remain qualified.
